title: FreedomTalk
subtitle: Real-time Communication Platform
description: A full-featured Discord clone built with a microservices architecture. Features real-time messaging via WebSockets, voice/video calls with WebRTC, server management, file attachments, and role-based permissions.
longDescription: FreedomTalk is a comprehensive real-time communication platform that replicates Discord's core functionality. Built as a monorepo with npm workspaces, it features a Fastify backend with Socket.io for real-time messaging, a Next.js frontend with React 19, and containerized infrastructure with Docker. The platform supports horizontal scaling through Redis pub/sub, includes a complete authentication system with 2FA, and implements WebRTC for voice and video communication.

features.title: Real-time Messaging
features.description: WebSocket-based instant messaging with Socket.io and Redis adapter for horizontal scaling across multiple server instances

features.title: Voice & Video Calls
features.description: WebRTC-powered voice and video communication with SFU architecture for efficient multi-party calls

features.title: Server Management
features.description: Create and manage servers with customizable channels, categories, and role-based permission systems

features.title: File Attachments
features.description: Secure file upload and storage via MinIO/S3-compatible object storage with preview generation

features.title: Message Features
features.description: Rich message interactions including reactions, replies, threading, and embeds with Open Graph metadata

features.title: User Presence
features.description: Real-time presence indicators, typing notifications, and custom status support

features.title: Authentication
features.description: Secure JWT-based authentication with httpOnly cookies, refresh tokens, and optional TOTP two-factor auth

features.title: Snowflake IDs
features.description: Distributed ID generation using Snowflake algorithm for sortable, unique identifiers across services

highlights: Monorepo architecture with npm workspaces and shared types package
Horizontal scaling support via Redis pub/sub adapter
Complete WebSocket event system with presence and room management
Database migrations with Knex and Snowflake ID generation
Containerized development environment with Docker Compose
